problem_statement: The ADC devicetree spec macros (ADC_DT_SPEC_GET_BY_NAME, ADC_DT_SPEC_INST_GET_BY_NAME, ADC_DT_SPEC_GET_BY_IDX, ADC_DT_SPEC_INST_GET_BY_IDX, ADC_DT_SPEC_GET, ADC_DT_SPEC_INST_GET) provide no way to supply a fallback default value when the devicetree node or io-channel property does not exist. Add _OR variants of each macro that accept a default_value argument and return it when the node, property, or channel index is absent, so callers can provide a safe fallback without explicit existence checks.

verification.reason: The task is fair once the public macro names, parameter order, and the fallback-on-invalid-instance behaviour are stated explicitly, because the hidden tests only rely on these observable interface requirements.

problems.detail: The hidden tests use the exact macro names ADC_DT_SPEC_GET_BY_NAME_OR, ADC_DT_SPEC_INST_GET_BY_NAME_OR, ADC_DT_SPEC_GET_BY_IDX_OR, and ADC_DT_SPEC_INST_GET_BY_IDX_OR, but the statement only refers generically to '_OR variants' and does not give the names or parameter order.
The hidden tests check that the INST_-style _OR macros also return the default when the devicetree instance index is invalid/absent, not only when the node or property is absent.

problem_statement_fixed: The ADC devicetree spec macros ADC_DT_SPEC_GET_BY_NAME, ADC_DT_SPEC_INST_GET_BY_NAME, ADC_DT_SPEC_GET_BY_IDX, ADC_DT_SPEC_INST_GET_BY_IDX, ADC_DT_SPEC_GET, and ADC_DT_SPEC_INST_GET provide no way to supply a fallback default value when the devicetree node or io-channel property does not exist. Add the _OR variants ADC_DT_SPEC_GET_BY_NAME_OR, ADC_DT_SPEC_INST_GET_BY_NAME_OR, ADC_DT_SPEC_GET_BY_IDX_OR, ADC_DT_SPEC_INST_GET_BY_IDX_OR, ADC_DT_SPEC_GET_OR, and ADC_DT_SPEC_INST_GET_OR. Each _OR macro should take the same arguments as the corresponding non-_OR macro plus a default_value argument. When the requested devicetree node, io-channel property, or channel index is present, the _OR macro must produce the same result as the corresponding non-_OR macro. When the requested node, property, or channel index is absent, including when the DT_DRV_COMPAT instance for an INST variant does not exist, the _OR macro must expand to the supplied default_value as a static initializer for struct adc_dt_spec, so callers can provide a safe fallback without explicit existence checks.
